name: Paul Bocuse
bio: French chef of Collonges-au-Mont-d'Or near Lyon. He made the Auberge du Pont de Collonges a three-star restaurant, cooked from the market and made the chef a public figure. He started the Bocuse d'Or in 1987.

milestones.event: The Auberge du Pont de Collonges won its third Michelin star.
Created the black truffle soup for a dinner at the Élysée Palace.
